tagline: Clear, calm, personalized explanations of your doctor's advice

safety.prototypeBannerBody: MedSarthi is an AI-thon educational prototype using synthetic cases only. It is NOT clinically validated, does not diagnose or prescribe, and must not replace a qualified doctor.
safety.prototypeFooter: Educational Prototype • Synthetic Data Only • Not Clinically Validated for Real Care • Always confirm medical decisions with your doctor.
safety.emergencyNote: If you have severe chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden weakness, or heavy bleeding, call 112 / 108 or go to the nearest emergency hospital immediately.
safety.emergencySeekCare: Do not wait for an app reply. Please call emergency services (112 or 108) or go to the nearest emergency hospital right away.
safety.integrityPassed: Safety Check Passed — Key medicines, doses, timing, and warnings match your doctor's note.
safety.integrityWarning: Safety Check Notice — Please double-check the highlighted details with your doctor or pharmacist.
safety.integrityBlocked: Safety Hold — This explanation could not be verified against the doctor's original note and is held for review.
safety.integrityDisclaimer: Automated consistency check comparing critical fields against the source note; this does not prove clinical correctness or replace professional review.
safety.medicineProhibition: Never start, stop, or change any medicine dose without asking your doctor or pharmacist.

landing.heroBadge: Doctor-Anchored Clinical Communication Bridge — Not a Generic Chatbot
landing.heroTitle: Understand your doctor's advice clearly, calmly, and in your own language.
landing.heroSubtitle: MedSarthi explains and translates only what your doctor provided alongside verified medical knowledge—never guessing unreadable prescriptions, never changing dosages, and adapting text size and voice playback to your comfort.
landing.guestWorkspaceDesc: Instant private workspace — upload reports, ask questions & listen with no sign-up

features.provenanceDesc: Doctor words, simple AI summary, verified medical facts, and unknowns kept visually separate.
features.multilingualDesc: One-tap language switch preserving consultation context and exact medicine numbers.
features.accessibleVoiceDesc: 64px+ touch targets, 0.75x–1.25x audio highlighting, high contrast, and Hinglish voice confirmation.
features.integrityGateDesc: Verifies doses, units, frequencies, and negations—and refuses to guess unclear OCR scans.

demo.subtitle: Instant synthetic login (zero external API keys required) or step through the 7-part judge walkthrough.
demo.patientDesc: Opens 6-action Patient Home with seeded URI + BP consultation & lab report
demo.doctorDesc: Opens Clinician Workspace with integrity check, OCR/audio tools & approve/share

steps.step1Desc: Experience age-aware defaults (age 64 -> XL text + 0.75x audio), zero jargon, and 'Hear this question'.
steps.step2Desc: Inspect Dr. Priya Mehta's immutable note (Acute Nasopharyngitis, Hypertension, Paracetamol, Amlodipine).
steps.step3Desc: See Doctor-Provided, In Simple Words, General Medical Knowledge (with citations), and Unknown items clearly separated.
steps.step4Desc: Switch between English, हिन्दी, and Hinglish without losing consultation context or altering dosages.
steps.step5Desc: Play audio at 0.75x–1.25x speed with synchronized line-by-line highlighting.
steps.step6Desc: Tap progressive Explain More buttons or tap underlined medical terms for curated SVG diagrams.
steps.step7Title: Ask: 'Kya iska matlab mujhe pneumonia hai?'
steps.step7Desc: Test MedSarthi's grounded Hinglish Q&A safety boundary against the doctor's URI note.
